roster.name: Maddox Pedon
roster.bio: 6,2 from Toledo, Ohio. Known for his rushing and ability to "annoy" the quarterback during the 7 banana blitz time.

roster.name: Maddox Marsaglia
roster.bio: Known for his freak athleticism, and crazy catches. Able to "moss" anyone in sight.

roster.name: Giovani Pelaez
roster.bio: Known for his height and ability to catch passes over any defender. Also good at the quarterback position.

roster.name: Bowen Ince
roster.bio: Nicknamed the "King". Known for athleticism, and abilty to run the ball.

roster.name: Liam Bair
roster.bio: Known for rushing and his annoyance to the QB.

roster.name: Finn Hopkins
roster.bio: Known for his all round ability, can throw, catch, and run.

roster.name: Clayton Kinsella
roster.bio: Known for his catches late in the game.

roster.name: Theo Miner
roster.bio: Known for his great defense and ability to stop throws from being caught.

roster.name: Luther Nuesken
roster.bio: Known for his ability to catch and run...great use on times where you need a quick pass.

roster.name: Xavier Davenport
roster.bio:
Known for his freak athleticism and ability to pick off passes. 

In early October he had a 3 INT, 1 TD game.

roster.name: Charlie Waddell
roster.bio: Great at the Quarterback position, able to catch and run the ball well despite his height.

roster.name: Carson Tabaka
roster.bio: Nicknamed "CT", "T-Time", or "Cars (car-se)". Known for his ability to bring chemistry to a team.

roster.name: Braxton Iliff-Murphy
roster.bio: Known for his great speed, able to catch, and run a ton of yards.

roster.name: Kamden Doage
roster.bio: Known for his ability on defense and how well he runs the ball and gets around defenders.

roster.name: Luka Corrales
roster.bio: Known for his athleticism and ability to jump over taller defenders and catch the ball.

roster.name: Wally Barrickman
roster.bio: Known for his speed especially late into the game.

roster.name: Dom Chiodo
roster.bio:
Known for just being there and having fun. 

Note that in his photo, he thought that it was Fishing, and not Football.

roster.name: Kayson Link
roster.bio: His team is named after him. Known for being a great and reliable QB.
